def: to urge along, i.e. stimulate (to hostility)

occurrences.text: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
